values.note: Campspot (the park's own engine), June 2027 rate table read before 2027 booking opens: every RV type (Standard Back-in, Water View Back-in and their accessible versions) $35 on Tuesday June 8 and $40 on Saturday June 12; primitive tent sites $18-20; cabins $75. Plus the park's $6 'Reservation Surcharge' once per stay and a 3% 'Credit Card Surcharge'; an optional $10 Site Lock Fee; Campspot adds its own booking fee (3%, at least $3). October 2026 was $35 on a Wednesday. One vehicle pass is included; extra vehicles buy a pass.

fees.source: https://www.campspot.com/book/big-bend-park (Campspot API for park 3690, campsite-types 34561/34563/34565 for 2027-06-08 and 2027-06-12: averagePricePerNightBeforeTaxesAndFees 35 / 40, feeSummary 'Reservation Surcharge' 6, 'Credit Card Surcharge', 'Site Lock Fee' 10; description 'All reservations include ONE vehicle pass'), read 2026-10-25; October 2026 quote from audit/price_research/campspot_tier_2026-10-13.jsonl

hookups.source: https://www.campspot.com/book/big-bend-park (Standard Back-in and Water View Back-in: 'All of our standard sites include water and electric hook-up', amenities 30-Amp, 50-Amp; 'We offer a dump station for all campers to dispose of their black and gray waters'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Campspot lists 122 RV sites (107 Standard Back-in, 13 Water View Back-in, 2 accessible) plus 5 primitive tent sites, 4 cabins and 33 boat docks. All back-in; 113 RV sites take motorhomes, 104 of them 23 ft or longer, up to 56 ft. A few short sites are for vans, truck campers and pop-ups only.

sites.source: https://www.campspot.com/book/big-bend-park (Campspot API campsite lists per type: rvTypes, rvLengthMax, amenities), read 2026-10-25. The derived 215 (note prose) is not supported by the park's engine.

facilities.source: https://www.campspot.com/book/big-bend-park ('We offer a dump station for all campers'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Booked on the park's Campspot page (Big Prairie Township Parks Commission d/b/a Big Bend Park); 2027 dates are not yet bookable online (October 2026). Cancelling 10+ days out (21 on holidays) costs $25 plus fees; later, the first 2 nights (holidays: no refund). Office phone (231) 689-6325.
